property.name: positioningrole
property.label: Role
property.description: The service this detector will provide. Help Cue: issues a context message to cue help in other components as soon as this component renders. Help Button: renders a button to cue contextual help on click. Help Request: logs an interaction requestinng that Help be added to this page.

property.name: positioningGroup
property.label: Positioning Group
property.description: A reference name for this component, similar to Component Id and used in conjunction with the 'Listens To' parameter. This field may be used in Reports, so choose a nice friendly name e.g. 'Contact Page'

property.name: helpContext
property.label: Help Context (Help Topic ID)
property.description: For the 'Help Cue' and 'Help Button' roles, information defining the contextualise request to issue. For example, a Help Topic ID or (for Fixed listings) the API name of an object.

property.name: logContextInteraction
property.label: Log Context Interaction
property.description: For the 'Help Cue' and 'Help Button' roles, check this box to log a Help Interaction as and when context messages are issued.

property.name: contextcheckinterval
property.label: Navigation Checking Interval
property.description: USE WITH DUE REGARD FOR MACHINE RESOURCES: Enter zero unless re-contextualisation is required. Enter a number greater than zero (representing milliseconds) to check for changes in user context (page address). Minimum recommended interval is 1000.

property.name: label
property.label: Button Text
property.description: For the 'Help Button' role, optional text to display alongside the icon.

property.name: HelpButtonTextSize
property.label: Button Text Size
property.description: For the 'Help Button' role, sets the font size of optional text.

property.name: HelpButtonTextStyle
property.label: Button Text Style
property.description: For the 'Help Button' role, controls how optional text wraps

property.name: HelpButtonTextWidth
property.label: Button Text Width
property.description: For the 'Help Button' role, sets the width of the optional text area.

property.name: HelpButtonPosition
property.label: Button Position
property.description: For the 'Help Button' role, controls button positioning.

property.name: UXTheme
property.label: Colour Scheme
property.description: Enter the name of a styling theme to override the global default Help colour scheme (available themes typically include 'Light' and 'Dark'). Leave blank to accept default theme.

property.name: BackgroundStyle
property.label: Background Style
property.description: Controls the background colour for the component as a whole.
